title: Claude Code plugin .lsp.json
description: Complete skeleton of a plugin's .lsp.json: LSP servers keyed by name. Mirrors the official plugins reference; no repo-specific policy. The same map is the inline form of plugin.json lspServers. The language-server binary is NOT bundled: users install it separately.
$comment: Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference#lsp-servers, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins#add-lsp-servers-to-your-plugin (verified 2026-09-18 against Claude Code 2.1.277). ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} and ${user_config.KEY} are substituted in command, args, env and workspaceFolder.

command.description: Language-server binary; must be on the user's PATH.

extensionToLanguage.description: File extension (with leading dot) to LSP language id, e.g. {".go": "go"}.

initializationOptions.description: Passed in the LSP initialize request.

diagnostics.description: Push diagnostics into Claude's context after edits. Default true.
